formats.name: discord_message
formats.notes: content up to 2000 chars; up to 10 embeds, 6000 chars total across embed text fields; global API rate 50 req/s per bot

formats.name: messenger_message
formats.notes: 24h standard window (7 days after click-to-message ad first message); Human Agent tag 7 days; up to 30 images per attachments array; automated bots must respond within 30 s; text length not confirmed

formats.name: instagram_dm
formats.notes: text up to 1000 bytes UTF-8 (about 500 Arabic chars); image png/jpeg 8 MB, up to 10 per message; audio, video, pdf 25 MB; private reply once per commenter within 7 days

formats.name: whatsapp_text
formats.notes: body 4096 chars; interactive body 1024, footer 60, header text 60; 3 reply buttons of 20 chars; list 10 rows; template body 1024 chars with other components; 24h customer service window; new portfolio limit 250 unique users per 24h outside window, scaling to 2000

formats.name: telegram_message
formats.notes: text 4096 chars; caption 1024; bots send files up to 50 MB, download up to 20 MB; about 1 msg/s per chat, 20/min per group, about 30/s bulk
